info.title: Prime Agent Studio public API
info.description: Generic documented v1 surface. Tokens are created locally in Studio Preferences; every request authenticates with `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Token management and API preferences stay local-only under /api/public-api and are not part of this contract.

servers.description: Studio chosen by the client (direct per-Studio calls).

403.description: Valid token without the needed scope or project.

get.summary: Read Computer Use availability and ownership without starting a worker, capture or input.
get.description: Optional sessionId OR runId, never both. Unknown, repeated, empty or malformed query parameters return 400. No target reads global state; an unauthorized or unknown target returns 404. Owner identifiers outside token projects are redacted. No owner name, cwd, lastAction, lastFrame, raw errors or backend paths are exposed.

403.description: Valid token without the needed scope or project.

post.summary: Authorize or revoke real desktop control for one target.
post.description: Explicit enabled state, not a toggle. Requires exactly one existing session (including idle) or active run. Uses the globally configured backend; never launches an agent, captures pixels or sends input. Disabling does not stop the agent run. Never takes over or stops another target, even in the same project. Reread after conflict or timeout; no automatic retry. Revision resets at server restart.

200.description: Current state after authorization or revocation.

409.description: Revision mismatch (currentRevision included), another target owns control, unavailable backend, vision-incompatible active model, or cleanup uncertainty. Reread; never retry automatically.

post.summary: Synchronize now through the configured R2 bucket and wait for the result.
post.description: With sessionId: sends and receives that one conversation, including one this Studio has never seen. Membership in projectId is checked after receipt; a conversation of another project returns 404. Without sessionId: one full cycle (all synced projects and roadmaps), only for tokens authorized on every synced project. A running cycle is awaited, never skipped. A conversation with an active run is not sent (state pending). Never starts, stops or resumes an agent.

get.summary: Download the bytes served by the machine holding the file.
get.description: Streaming with no application cap. Validators are checked per request against the live file, not an immutable snapshot. Wait for the producer to finish writing before downloading; bytes are not frozen during a transfer. One single Range per request: a valid range answers 206 with Content-Range; an unsatisfiable, malformed or multi-range value answers 416 with Content-Range bytes */size. If-Range with a stale validator re-downloads the whole file as 200 instead of mixing versions. If-None-Match or If-Modified-Since matching the current ETag/mtime answers 304; a failed If-Match or If-Unmodified-Since precondition answers 412.

state.description: Conversation sync state after the call: synced, pending (a run is active, nothing sent) or off.

changed.description: True when this call received newer content from the bucket.

revision.description: Process-local; resets at server restart. Reread after conflict or timeout, never retry automatically.

enabled.description: Selected target owns Computer Use; without a target, any global owner is present.

ownerHidden.description: Unauthorized owner identifiers are redacted; availability and busy remain visible.

capabilities.description: Currently projects, conversations, runs, roadmaps, files and computer-use.

StopResult.description: Stop acknowledgement plus the current Run projection fields.

RoadmapCompletion.description: Server-owned completion. machineId equals GET /machine on the Studio that executed the check; after sync it may differ from the current envelope Studio. sessionId is the associated conversation (project membership checked) or null without context; natively the verified actual caller (child, not root).

machineId.description: Stable identity of the Studio that executed the check (GET /machine there; may differ from the reading Studio after sync).

sessionId.description: Associated conversation selected by the caller (project membership checked), or null without context. Natively the verified actual caller.

completedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds when the step was checked.

completion.description: Null when undone or when a historical done step predates attribution; otherwise the executing Studio, associated conversation and time (after sync, the executing Studio may differ from the reading Studio).

children.description: Checklists accept three levels and 2 000 steps at most.

RoadmapDocument.description: Current roadmap DTO, identical to the native document minus cwd. Step completion is output/read-only; its machineId is the executing Studio and may differ from the envelope machineId after sync.
